summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package is published under the @servicetitan scope with description 'Utils' and its declared main (dist/index.js) is a 76-byte re-export of cypress selectors (`export * from './utils/chat-ui-selectors';`). Its package.json declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`, which probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads Bun v1.3.13 from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<target>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. The executed sibling file `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle heavily obfuscated with a mixed numeric/string array, an array-rotation function, and a decoder — not human-readable, no source shipped, and unrelated to cypress test selectors. The install-time flow uses a second, non-Node runtime to execute opaque bundled code that Node-focused review will not inspect. Advertised purpose (cypress selector helper) does not match install-time behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
